# Comment stripping that SPIT and the editor extension must agree on.
# Each case is an `in:` line, then the `out:` line SPIT keeps as code.
# Read by src/parser/lexical.rs and by spit-vscode's tests.
in:source raw [id]
out:source raw [id]
in:source raw [id] # a note
out:source raw [id] 
in:# a whole-line comment
out:
in:  # indented comment
out:  
in:command c: tool --color=#fff {input}
out:command c: tool --color=#fff {input}
in:command c: tool word# note
out:command c: tool word# note
in:command c: tool '# quoted' {input}
out:command c: tool '# quoted' {input}
in:command c: tool "# quoted" {input}
out:command c: tool "# quoted" {input}
in:command c: tool "a \" # still quoted" # then a comment
out:command c: tool "a \" # still quoted" 
in:command c: tool 'it\' # a backslash does not escape in single quotes
out:command c: tool 'it\' 
in:command c: tool \# escaped
out:command c: tool \# escaped
in:tab	# after a tab
out:tab	
in:nbsp # after a no-break space
out:nbsp 
in:bom﻿# after a byte order mark
out:bom﻿# after a byte order mark
in:ideographic　# after an ideographic space
out:ideographic　
in:unclosed 'quote # no comment
out:unclosed 'quote # no comment
in:
out:
